spec.assertion: buffApply stat critDamagePct value 18.7, targetSlug mihara, >=5 applications, durationShots undefined + finite expiresFrame; removing skill1 lowers only her total (allies byte-identical). Fails under: passive/always-on encoding (1 apply), critRatePct or critRateNormalPct stat swap, durationShots (round-count) semantics, ally-scoped target.

In the two-B3 comp the count of her 15.56 atkPct applications never exceeds the number of full-burst windows and all applications target herself. Fails under fullBurstEnter keying, which fires on any team full burst (count === fullBurstStart) and over-credits whenever another Burst III completes the chain.

buffApply atkPct 15.56 self on every own cast (>=2), time-based (no durationShots). Fails under casterAtkPct/flat encoding (value would re-emit as a flat ATK number, not 15.56) or a round-count duration.

critRateApplies === atkApplies - 1 — the escalating identity (Nth activation applies steps 1..N). Fails under the nearest-wrong flat model where both stats are granted on every cast (counts equal), and under a dropped step 2 (count 0).

A fullBurstExtend effect with seconds < 0 (and === -5) exists; stripping it RAISES team damage and raises the count of inFullBurst damage events. Fails under a sign flip (+5 extend), under omission (patched === baseline, no movement), and under an unmodeled/GAP filing.

A burst-slot flatDamage atkPct 399.6 exists, and no burst-bucket damage event carries fbMajorApplied (burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens — verified project fact). Fails under an FB-eligible encoding of the burst hit.

A burst-slot flatDamage 266.4 exists, its block carries at least one gate field, and stripping every gate field strictly RAISES her total (the rider then also lands on cast #1). Also asserts it is enemy damage, not a buff (no buffApply with value 266.4/399.6). Fails under an ungated rider (totals collapse), under omission (no rider effect found), and under a buff mis-encoding.

fixtures: Primary: controlComp('mihara', false) — the fixed second Burst III is dropped so mihara is the SOLE B3 and casts on every rotation, which is what makes the S2 escalation count identity (crit === atk - 1) readable and makes every burst-slot counterfactual a clean single-caster comparison; liter (B1) + crown (B2) still supply the chain so full bursts actually happen (a lone B3 with no enablers makes ZERO). Secondary: controlComp('mihara', true) — used for exactly one assertion, the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter trigger-identity check, which is only meaningful when another Burst III can take rotations. 6 hoisted runs total (base, no-skill1, no-FB-shorten, no-rider, ungated-rider, two-B3), each a full 180s sim.
